parameters.query:
select o.order_id, o.intent, o.decision, o.status, o.confidence, o.sap_order_number, o.started_at,
  extract(epoch from (o.finished_at - o.started_at))::int as seconds,
  (select count(*) from al_poc.step_log s where s.order_id = o.order_id) as steps,
  (select count(*) from al_poc.step_log s where s.order_id = o.order_id and s.step = 'guard') as guards,
  (select sum(coalesce(s.tokens_in, 0) + coalesce(s.tokens_out, 0)) from al_poc.step_log s where s.order_id = o.order_id) as tokens,
  (select round(extract(epoch from (coalesce(d.resolved_at, now()) - d.created_at)) / 60, 1) from al_poc.draft_orders d where d.order_id = o.order_id order by d.id desc limit 1) as desk_minutes
from al_poc.order_intake o order by o.started_at desc limit 25;

parameters.content:
## Metrics dashboard: GET /al-pg-order-metrics

Serves an HTML page over order_intake and step_log: orders received, automation rate, auto posted, sent to the order desk, failures, average end-to-end seconds, average confidence, and the last 25 orders. Refreshes every 15 s. Production: the same queries feed Looker or Power BI.
